storage.sql:
CREATE TABLE datasets (
	scene VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	band VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	path VARCHAR(8000), 
	PRIMARY KEY (scene, band)
)

CREATE TABLE key_names (
	key_name VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	description VARCHAR(8000), 
	idx INTEGER, 
	PRIMARY KEY (key_name), 
	UNIQUE (idx)
)

CREATE TABLE metadata (
	scene VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	band VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	bounds_north FLOAT, 
	bounds_east FLOAT, 
	bounds_south FLOAT, 
	bounds_west FLOAT, 
	convex_hull TEXT, 
	valid_percentage FLOAT, 
	min FLOAT, 
	max FLOAT, 
	mean FLOAT, 
	stdev FLOAT, 
	percentiles BLOB, 
	metadata TEXT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (scene, band)
)

CREATE TABLE terracotta (
	version VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (version)
)
